name: omARR
description: Arr stack for self-hosted services (Sonarr, Radarr, SABnzbd, qBittorrent, Jellyfin, any URL): health, active downloads and outages in the bar; a panel with the fleet, now playing, on deck, recently added, the calendar and the queues, pause and resume; notifications for grabs, imports, finished or failed downloads and services that drop, and a live download card. Off by default. API keys and passwords stay in a private state file, never in shell.json

services.description: The fleet, edited in the panel's settings: {id, kind (generic, sonarr, radarr, sabnzbd, qbittorrent, jellyfin), name, url, group, order, showQueue, showCalendar, notifyGrab, notifyImport, notifyHealth, notifyDownload}. Keys and passwords are not stored here

pollSeconds.description: Seconds between polls of every service (5-3600). SABnzbd and qBittorrent are polled every 2 s while a download runs or the panel is open

density.description: Panel row spacing: comfortable or compact

showProgressToast.description: While SABnzbd or qBittorrent downloads, keep a notification with its progress up until the job ends or the notification is closed

debugIpc.description: Test hook: expose IPC target haseen.omarr (state, poll)
